question: One evening, Ram and Shyam are talking face-to-face with each other. If Shyam's shadow was exactly to the right of Ram, in which direction was Shyam facing?
solution:
Given: 

One evening, Ram and Shyam are talking face-to-face with each other.

Shyam's shadow was exactly to the right of Ram.

As In the evening, the sun sets in the west, so shadows fall towards the east. Shyam's shadow was exactly to the right of Ram which means shadow was to the left of Shyam's left. So, if Shyam's left is east then he was facing south. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381be84240e30618e9caf2d0a73dd6520e2cdfc31ef81b05f7a5d18924d9ca1.png] 

 

Thus, Shyam was facing south direction.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
